## W04 Accountability and oversight

W04   Workflow ID __________   Version/date __________   Status __________

Prepared by __________   Accountable owner __________   Evidence location __________

Done when: every role has a named person and alternate with recorded authority; Tier 3 Reviewer, Approver and Owner are distinct; any other combined role carries a recorded rationale; and an intervention has been shown working.

Source basis: [Slow AI Kitchen](https://github.com/rolldabones/slow-ai-kitchen) · [GRC Workbook](https://github.com/rolldabones/grc-workbook)

| **Role** | **Named person and alternate** | **Authority and evidence** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Executive Sponsor | ________________ | ________________ |
| Organizational AI Owner | ________________ | ________________ |
| AI Operator and Builder | ________________ | ________________ |
| Task Preparer | ________________ | ________________ |
| Task Reviewer | ________________ | ________________ |
| Task Approver | ________________ | ________________ |
| Task Owner | ________________ | ________________ |
| Technical and control owners | ________________ | ________________ |

For Kitchen task Tier 3, Reviewer, Approver and Owner must be distinct. Other role combinations require a recorded rationale. The organizational AI Owner and task Owner are different responsibilities even if held by one person.

**Prove that oversight can operate**

What does the reviewer know? What can they pause, restrict or revoke? What information and time do they receive? Show the intervention working.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Escalation route and absence coverage**

Name contacts, response expectations, deputy authority and who can authorize restart.
